_masks_comment: Every mask this preference touches (ROI, non-ROI, and anything referenced by name in the optimizer's constraint-group tables or background_mask_name below) -- a FROZEN COPY of each one's recipe from whichever mask_recipes/*.json book they were picked from on Config Generation, not a live reference to that book. Frozen on purpose: this preference behaves identically later even if the book is edited or deleted afterward. Apply Preference builds whichever of these a given subject is still missing (mask_recipe_discovery.build_missing_masks -- same code Config Generation's own 'Build missing masks' button calls), in dependency order, before generating configs. Two recipe kinds -- see mask_recipes/_template.json for the full shape.
